topic: Finding company contact information and data
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on locating centralized storage for company email addresses. Initially, a query against `company_dict` was insufficient. [me] advised that the information exists but is historically complexly structured. For viewing contacts visually across multiple companies and checking production data, [p1] was directed to use the analytics dashboard at `mods.allunite.com`. Specifically, accessing the customer accounts section (`https://mods.allunite.com/accounts/customers`) allows searching and viewing contact details.
decisions: The primary location for viewing company contacts is the dedicated customer accounts section on the mods platform.
